Define a 2D polynomial family $f(x,y) = a_0 + a_1 x + a_2 y + a_3 xy$ with explicit equality constraints $f(x_i,y_i) = c_i$ for $i=1..w$. Vary $w \in [1, 4]$ (max independent constraints for 4 parameters) and sweep hidden width $N \in [1, 50]$ for a 2-layer MLP with ReLU activation. Training protocol: minimize $\mathcal{L} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{j} (f_{MLP}(\mathbf{x}_j) - y_j)^2 + \lambda \sum_{i=1}^w \left(f_{MLP}(\mathbf{x}_i^c) - c_i\right)^2$ with $\lambda=10^3$, Adam optimizer, 10k epochs, early stopping if validation loss plateaus for 100 epochs. Validation: hold out 20% of constraint points not used in loss; measure max absolute violation on held-out constraints. $N_c(w)$ defined as minimum $N$ where violation $\leq 10^{-3}$ on all held-out constraints. Baseline: unconstrained fitting (no penalty term, same architecture). Rigidity test: if $N_c(w)$ remains bounded as $w \to w_{max}$, solution space is rigid; if $N_c(w) \to \infty$, solution space is fat.
